Welcome to the Papillon Engineering interactive circuit laboratory. Use the simulation workbench below to build, wire, and analyze DC/AC circuits, filters, and operational amplifiers.

::: {.callout-note}
If you prefer an isolated workspace or are presenting in class, you can open the simulation in a dedicated full-screen window: [Launch Full-Screen Simulator ↗](https://www.falstad.com/circuit/circuitjs.html){target="_blank"}
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
### Quick Instructions
* **Placing Components:** Use the top menu (**Draw > Passive Components** or **Active Components**) to select resistors, capacitors, sources, and semiconductors.
* **Wiring:** Click and drag your mouse between component nodes to draw connection wires.
* **Control:** Use the buttons on the right to **Run/Stop** the simulation or **Reset** the workspace.
:::
